name: CRC-SigBench
description: Background and rationale Prognostic transcriptomic signatures for colorectal cancer (CRC) have been published for over two decades, but their reported performance is rarely re-estimated on independent cohorts, and the degree to which analytical freedom (gene-set selection, cut-point choice, cohort selection) contributes to published claims is unknown. This project audits 320 published CRC prognostic signatures under a single, uniformly applied pipeline across eight public cohorts. Registration status. This registration is retrospective: the literature audit, all cohort processing, and all primary analyses had been completed before registration. The analysis plan below reflects the pre-specified decision rules that governed the pipeline before result matrices were locked; it is deposited to make those rules citable and time-stamped, not to claim confirmatory status. Sections marked exploratory were conducted without locked decision rules and are reported as such in the manuscript. Data All input cohorts are publicly available and are rebuilt from primary sources by the deposited pipeline; no private data are used.
